Parcel-level permutation null

Source: R/null_factories.R
null_parcel_perm.Rd

Used internally by hier_scan(). For each draw, voxel signs are flipped independently at the voxel level (the same family used by null_voxel_signflip() but exposed for hierarchical workflows).

Usage

null_parcel_perm(
  stat_vol,
  parcels = NULL,
  mask = NULL,
  n_perm = 5000,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

stat_vol

Observed (canonicalized) Z-equivalent map.

parcels

A ClusteredNeuroVol, integer label array, or vector aligned with stat_vol.

mask

Optional logical 3D mask.

n_perm

Number of draws.

seed

Optional random seed.

Value

A null_spec with kind = "parcel_perm".
